abstract: In this paper we compare expected loss minimization to worst-case or minimax analysis in the design of simple Taylor-style rules for monetary policy using a small model estimated for the euro area by Orphanides and Wieland (2000). We find that rules optimized under a minimax objective in the presence of general parameter and shock uncertainty do not imply extreme policy activism. Such rules tend to obey the Brainard principle of cautionary policy-making in much the same way as rules derived by expected loss minimization. Rules derived by means of minimax analysis are effective insurance policies limiting maximum loss over ranges of parameter values to be set by the policy-maker. In practice, we propose to set these ranges with an eye towards the cost of such insurance cover in terms of the implied increase in expected inflation variability.
abstract_zh: 本文通过奥法尼德斯和维兰德（2000）估算的欧元区小型模型，比较了简单泰勒规则货币政策设计中预期损失最小化与最坏情况（即极小化极大分析）两种方法。研究发现，在存在一般参数和冲击不确定性的情况下，基于极小化极大目标优化的规则并不会导致极端的政策激进性。这类规则倾向于遵循布雷纳德审慎决策原则，其方式与通过预期损失最小化推导的规则高度相似。通过极小化极大分析推导的规则是有效的保险策略，能够将政策制定者设定的参数区间内的最大损失限制在可控范围内。在实践中，我们建议根据此类保险覆盖的成本（以隐含的预期通胀波动性增加来衡量）来设定这些参数区间。
title: Stochastic Optimization and Worst Case Analysis in Monetary Policy Design
title_zh: DP5019 货币政策设计中的随机优化与最坏情况分析

abstract: This paper tests the insiders? dilemma hypothesis in a laboratory experiment. The insiders? dilemma means that a profitable merger does not occur, because it is even more profitable for each firm to unilaterally stand as an outsider (Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990 and 1993). The experimental data provides support for the insiders? dilemma, and thereby for endogenous rather than exogenous merger theory. More surprisingly, our data suggests that fairness (or relative performance) considerations also make profitable mergers difficult. Mergers that should occur in equilibrium do not, since they require an unequal split of surplus.
abstract_zh: 本文通过实验室实验检验了内部人困境假说。内部人困境是指一项有利可图的合并未能发生，因为每个企业单方面作为局外人反而能获得更高利润（Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990, 1993）。实验数据支持内部人困境的存在，从而验证了内生性合并理论而非外生性合并理论。更令人意外的是，我们的数据表明，公平性（或相对绩效）考量同样阻碍了有利可图的合并。本应在均衡状态下发生的合并未能实现，原因在于这些合并要求对剩余进行不平等分配。
title: The Insiders' Dilemma: An Experiment on Merger Formation
title_zh: DP5016 内部人的困境：合并形成的实验研究

abstract: We examine the effect of close ties with the NSDAP on the stock price of listed firms in 1932-33. We consider not only links between the National Socialists and executives, as was common in earlier work, but also with supervisory board members ? whose importance is hard to overestimate in the case of German industry. One implication of our work is that, weighted by stock market capitalization in 1932, more than half of listed firms on the Berlin stock exchange had substantive links with the NSDAP. Crucially, stock market investors recognized the value of these links, sending the share prices of connected firms up as the new regime became firmly established. While the market as a whole rose after Hitler?s accession to power, firms with board members known to favour the party (or backing it financially) outperformed the market by 5-10% between January and May 1933. We show that this finding is robust to a range of additional control variables and alternative estimation techniques.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1932-1933年间与纳粹党（NSDAP）的密切关系对上市公司股票价格的影响。我们不仅考虑了纳粹党与高管之间的联系（这在早期研究中较为常见），还关注了与监事会成员的联系——在德国工业的背景下，后者的重要性无论如何强调都不为过。我们的研究结论之一是，按1932年股票市值加权计算，柏林证券交易所超过一半的上市公司与纳粹党存在实质性联系。关键在于，股票市场投资者认识到了这些联系的价值，随着新政权稳固建立，关联企业的股价随之上涨。尽管希特勒上台后整个市场整体上扬，但在1933年1月至5月期间，董事会成员已知支持该党（或为其提供资金支持）的企业表现优于市场5-10%。我们证明，这一发现在一系列额外控制变量和替代估计方法下依然稳健。
title: Betting on Hitler - The Value of Political Connections in Nazi Germany
title_zh: 押注希特勒——纳粹德国政治关联的价值

abstract: The objective of this paper is to understand the implications for consumption and portfolio choice of the separation of an investor?s risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution that is made possible by recursive utility, in contrast to expected utility, where the two are governed by the same parameter. In particular, we study exactly how risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution affect optimal dynamic consumption and portfolio decisions. For a three-date, discrete-time model with a stochastic interest rate, we obtain an exact analytic solution for the optimal consumption and portfolio policies. We find that, in general, the consumption and portfolio decisions depend on both risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Only in the case where the investment opportunity set is constant, is the optimal portfolio weight independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We also find that the size of risk aversion relative to unity determines the sign of the intertemporal hedging component in the optimal portfolio, while elasticity of intertemporal substitution affects only the magnitude of the hedging component.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解递归效用（recursive utility）相较于预期效用（expected utility）所实现的投资者风险厌恶（risk aversion）与跨期替代弹性（elasticity of intertemporal substitution）分离对消费与投资组合选择的影响——在预期效用框架下，两者由同一参数决定。具体而言，我们精确研究了风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性如何影响最优动态消费与投资组合决策。针对一个包含随机利率的三期离散时间模型，我们推导出最优消费与投资组合策略的精确解析解。研究发现，一般而言，消费与投资组合决策同时取决于风险厌恶和跨期替代弹性。仅当投资机会集恒定时，最优投资组合权重才独立于跨期替代弹性。我们还发现，风险厌恶相对于1的大小决定了最优投资组合中跨期对冲成分的符号，而跨期替代弹性仅影响对冲成分的幅度。
title: The Role of Risk Aversion and Intertemporal Substitution in Dynamic Consumption-Portfolio Choicewith Recursive Utility
title_zh: 风险厌恶与跨期替代在递归效用动态消费-投资组合选择中的作用

abstract: This study deals with educational production in Austria and is focused on the potential impact of schoolmates on students? academic outcomes. We used PISA 2000 data to estimate peer effects for 15 and 16 year old students. The estimations yield substantial positive effects of the peer groups? socioeconomic composition on student achievement. Furthermore, quantile regressions suggest peer effects to be asymmetric in favour of low-ability students, meaning that students with lower skills benefit more from being exposed to clever peers, whereas those with higher skills do not seem to be affected much. Social heterogeneity, moreover, has no big adverse effect on academic outcomes. These results imply considerable social gains of reducing stratification in educational settings.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨奥地利的学校教育产出，重点关注同学对学生学业成果的潜在影响。我们利用PISA 2000数据，对15至16岁学生的同伴效应进行估计。估计结果显示，同伴群体的社会经济构成对学生成绩具有显著的正向影响。此外，分位数回归表明，同伴效应存在不对称性，且有利于低能力学生，即技能较低的学生更易从与聪明同伴的接触中受益，而技能较高的学生似乎未受显著影响。同时，社会异质性对学业成果并无显著负面作用。这些结果意味着，减少教育环境中的分层现象可带来可观的社会收益。
title: Peer Effects in Austrian Schools
title_zh: 奥地利学校中的同伴效应

abstract: We develop a simple overlapping generations model in which the young have a choice in investing in equities and index-linked bonds. Projections of share price uncertainty over a 30-year period show that the risk associated with such a long-term investment predicts an equity premium that matches historical values.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简单的世代交叠模型，其中年轻人可以选择投资于股票和指数挂钩债券。对30年期内股价不确定性的预测表明，此类长期投资所伴随的风险所预测的股权溢价与历史数据吻合。
title: Explaining The Equity Risk Premium

abstract: This paper exploits the division of Germany after the Second World War and the reunification of East and West Germany in 1990 as a natural experiment to provide evidence of the importance of market access for economic development. In line with a standard new economic geography model, we find that following division cities in West Germany that were close to the new border between East and West Germany experienced a substantial decline in population growth relative to other West German cities. We provide several pieces of evidence that the decline of the border cities can be entirely accounted for by their loss in market access and is neither driven by differences in industrial structure nor differences in the degree of war related destruction. Finally, we also find some first evidence of a recovery of the border cities after the reunification of East and West Germany.
abstract_zh: 本文利用二战后德国分裂及1990年东西德统一作为自然实验，为市场准入对经济发展的重要性提供了证据。与标准的新经济地理模型一致，我们发现，分裂后，西德靠近东西德新边界的城市相对于其他西德城市经历了人口增长的显著下降。我们提供了多项证据表明，边境城市的衰退完全可归因于其市场准入的丧失，既非产业结构差异所致，也非战争破坏程度差异造成。最后，我们还发现了东西德统一后边境城市复苏的初步证据。
china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: The Costs of Remoteness: Evidence from German Division and Reunification
title_zh: 偏远地区的代价：来自德国分裂与统一的证据

abstract: We characterize the optimal renegotiation-proof contract in a dynamic Principal-Agent model in which the type of the agent may change stochastically over time. Contrary to the case with constant types, the ex ante optimal contract may be renegotiation-proof even if types are highly correlated. The marginal benefit of having some pooling of types in the first period is not monotonic in their persistence level, but the equilibrium level of pooling is non-decreasing in persistence; and, for any level persistence, it is always optimal to partially screen the types by offering a menu of choices to the agent. Despite the non-linearity of the problem, the optimal equilibrium allocation is unique.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了在代理人类型可能随时间随机变化的动态委托-代理模型中，最优的防再谈判契约特征。与类型恒定情形相反，即使类型高度相关，事前最优契约也可能具有防再谈判性质。第一期对部分类型进行混同的边际收益并非随其持续性水平单调变化，但均衡混同程度随持续性递增；且对于任意持续性水平，通过向代理人提供选择菜单进行部分甄别始终是最优策略。尽管该问题具有非线性特征，但最优均衡配置具有唯一性。
title: Optimality and Renegotiation in Dynamic Contracting
title_zh: 动态合同中的最优性与再谈判

abstract: We develop democratic mechanisms where individual utilities are not observable by other people at the legislative stage. We show that an appropriate combination of three rules can yield efficient provision of public projects: first, flexible and double majority rules where the size of the majority depends on the proposal and verifiable parameters and taxed and non-taxed individuals need to support the proposal; second, flexible agenda costs where the agenda-setter has to pay a certain amount of money if his proposal does not generate enough supporting votes; third, a ban on subsidies. We provide a rationale why double majority rules are used in practice. We also show that higher degrees of uncertainty about project parameters can make it easier to achieve first-best allocations and that universal equal treatment with regard to taxation is undesirable.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了在立法阶段个体效用不为他人所知的民主机制。研究表明，三种规则的适当组合能够实现公共项目的有效供给：其一，灵活的双重多数规则——多数规模取决于提案内容与可验证参数，且纳税人与非纳税人均需支持该提案；其二，灵活的议程成本机制——若议程设定者的提案未获得足够支持票数，则需支付特定金额；其三，禁止补贴条款。本文为实践中采用双重多数规则提供了理论依据，同时证明项目参数不确定性程度的提高反而更易实现最优配置，且税收领域的普遍平等对待并不可取。
title: Democratic Mechanisms: Double Majority Rules and Flexible Agenda Costs
title_zh: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本

abstract: We examine wage bargaining in a two-sector economy when the employers and labour unions in each sector are not always aware of all the general equilibrium feedback effects. We show analytically that if agents only consider labour demand effects, low real wages and low unemployment are the result. With an intermediate view, i.e. when partial equilibrium effects within a sector are taken into account, high real wages and unemployment result. If all general equilibrium effects are simultaneously considered, we once again obtain a situation of low wages and unemployment. The assumption that unions and employers' federations are unable to incorporate all feedback effects from other sectors may explain why unemployment in Europe is high.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了两部门经济中的工资谈判问题，假设各部门的雇主和工会并非总能意识到所有一般均衡反馈效应。我们通过分析证明：若经济主体仅考虑劳动力需求效应，将导致实际工资和失业率均处于低位；若采用中间视角（即考虑部门内的局部均衡效应），则会产生高实际工资和高失业率；若同时考虑所有一般均衡效应，则会再次出现低工资和低失业率的局面。工会与雇主联合会无法纳入其他部门全部反馈效应的假设，或可解释欧洲失业率居高不下的原因。
title: Awareness of General Equilibrium Effects and Unemployment
title_zh: 一般均衡效应与失业的认知
